name: Sunscreen Lotion
description: Guidelines for traveling with sunscreen lotion in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Sunscreen in carry-on bags is restricted by the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Containers must be 3.4 ounces (100 ml) or less. Larger quantities must be packed in checked bags.
conditions: Carry-on sunscreen containers must fit inside a single quart-sized, clear plastic bag.
Squeeze bottles or sprays are subject to the same volume constraints.
